implementedSubset: Parse and retain original HWPX hp:seg attributes, type identity, ordering, and lexical coordinate strings.
Expose editable point chains only for connected known LINE/CURVE segments with integer endpoints.
Move a shared endpoint in both adjacent segment records; keep a closed path closed.
Serialize edited endpoints while retaining original segment metadata and refusing unsupported segment types.

Split only a childless standard HWPX LINE record with exactly type/x1/y1/x2/y2 at an interior integer point on the line; join only adjacent eligible collinear LINE records. Preserve source attributes/order, closed-path structure, and unrelated OPC parts.
unresolvedRequirements: The current official KS X 6101:2024 CurveType schema defines hp:seg with a type and x1/y1/x2/y2 endpoints, but no editable Bezier control-point fields. The separate ConnectLineType controlPoints model is not a curve contract.
Bezier control-point editing has no verified serialization representation in the supported HWPX contract. Do not synthesize undocumented attributes or child elements.

CURVE segment insertion/deletion remains unsupported because endpoint-only samples and the standard do not specify interpolation/control data needed to reproduce or split the curve safely. LINE split/join is now supported only for exact standard, childless LINE source envelopes; extended, ambiguous, non-collinear, endpoint, and unsupported segment operations remain fail-closed.

formatEvidence.source: Hancom HWPML 3.0 Revision 1.2, section 5.6.6, table 140 SEGMENT
formatEvidence.finding: The 2012 HWPML table defines only Line/Curve type and endpoint coordinates; this historical reference is not used as the sole evidence for the current format. It does not prove that proprietary extensions do not exist.

currentOfficialStandard.source: e나라표준인증 KS X 6101:2024 machine-readable standard, revision 03, active; operation date 2024-10-30; Annex E ParaList XML Schema, CurveType
currentOfficialStandard.schemaFinding: Annex E CurveType contains an unbounded sequence of seg. Each seg has exactly type (default CURVE; enum LINE/CURVE), x1, y1, x2, y2 integer attributes, with no child elements or xs:any wildcard. ConnectLineType separately defines controlPoints/point; that is not a CurveType contract.
currentOfficialStandard.conclusion: The supported current schema does not provide an editable Bezier control-point serialization contract. Keep those mutations fail-closed unless a compatible authentic extension/sample establishes one.

rhwpModelReview.finding: The parser builds a point chain from each hp:seg start/end pair and leaves the HWP5-specific segment_types field empty for HWPX. The writer emits endpoint hp:seg records from that chain. The added ordered patch records whether each source hp:seg had children and exposes structural split/join only for childless LINE records with exactly the five standard attributes. The geul edit path retains segment metadata/order and original segment types outside the touched LINE records; unsupported source envelopes are rejected.
rhwpModelReview.revalidated: 2026-11-27 at pinned RHWP 1a76570e833917d15817415a53c09ad61ab3203f. The HWPX parser reduces each seg to endpoint point-chain entries, leaves HWP5-specific segment_types empty for HWPX, and the writer emits hp:seg endpoint pairs.

sampleCorpusAudit.source: Tracked repository corpus external/rhwp/samples/**/*.hwpx; aggregate counts are observational and cannot prove no proprietary extension exists.
sampleCorpusAudit.conclusion: The inspected compatible examples agree with the current schema, but the sample corpus cannot prove that no proprietary extension exists anywhere.
